Sola lettura. Le risorse sono generate d: Read-only. Resources are generated from stored data; writes are not accepted. Searches return a searchset Bundle with an exact total — the count covers every session matching the filters, not a sample — and paging follows link.next. Where an exact count would require scanning too many sessions the response is 413 with OperationOutcome too-costly, instead of an incomplete total. Patient/{id}/$everything is not paged and returns all of the patient's sessions, or 413 too-costly if they exceed the limit.
